name: story-root
comment:scripts: Every service is a workspace with its own config, so every service script here is a passthrough and the root has no Vite of its own (§7). `dev:multi-engine-server` has no `build` sibling on purpose: the node server runs its TypeScript directly under `tsx`, no build step and no `dist/` (§7). `test`/`test:watch` are Vitest and replace the mocha scripts Phase 0 deleted; the runner is at the root with one `vitest.workspace.ts` listing the packages that have tests (§7), so there is no per-workspace `test` passthrough to add. Parallel `dev` orchestration is Phase 11.

scripts.build: yarn typecheck && yarn workspace @story/single-engine build && yarn workspace @story/visualizer-client build && yarn workspace @story/multi-engine-client build

comment:dependencies: A real workspace root: tooling only (§7). Every runtime dependency now sits in the workspace that imports it. `react`/`react-dom` are not listed here — they are declared by the two apps at an exact version and pinned once through `resolutions` below, which is what keeps a single copy on disk (§10 risk 3). Deleted in Phase 8 rather than moved: `d3`, `@types/d3`, `jlouvain`, `ngraph.forcelayout`, `ngraph.graph` — zero imports anywhere in the repo, they predate the refactor; and `vite-tsconfig-paths`, whose last consumer was the deleted root Vite config. `vitest`/`@vitest/ui` are root-only by design — one runner over `vitest.workspace.ts`, no per-package copy (§7) — and they are the reason `jsdom`/`@types/jsdom` were kept back in Phase 0: Vitest uses jsdom as its DOM environment, for the React packages that will get tests later. `mocha`, `@types/mocha`, `sinon`, `@types/sinon` and `ts-node` are gone for good; doubles are `vi.fn`/`vi.spyOn` (§7).
comment:resolutions: `react`/`react-dom` are pinned per §10 risk 3 — two copies break hooks silently. `vite` is pinned for the same class of reason: Vitest declares `vite` as a plain dependency with a wide range (`^5 || ^6 || ^7`), so an unpinned install nests a second, newer Vite under `vitest/` and the test runner then transforms the source with a different Vite than the one that builds the apps. The repo is a Vite 5 repo (§7, every app on `vite@^5.4.9`); this keeps the runner on it.
